content.comment_body: Hello everyone, after changing the mode on my [product_name] [version_no], I activated the switch to OP and now I can't figure out how to return to the main menu. Could someone assist me?

You need to access the setup menu. There, select 'Switch to Admin' and confirm your selection. Then enter the password using the cursor keys. The password is usually 'logo' unless it has been changed. Confirm with OK.
Thank you for your assistance, my issue is now resolved. I appreciate your help.
A new question posted by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread with the topic 'Change the password for [article_no]'. Best regards [user_name]
